metadata.label: HSTS headers
metadata.measurement: C++ public HSTS parse API + Rust bridge + reused Rust number parser; caller output construction and policy consumption; warm preloaded input; no network/TLS/browser startup
metadata.baseline: Frozen original C++ HSTS parser, numeric helper and HttpUtil iterator helpers; matching native call boundaries and flags.
metadata.build_path: Canonical configured Chromium GN build (D:/RustiumBuild/src/out/Default); actual flags and binary hashes archived.
metadata.chart_scope: Public C++ API + Rust bridge / warm input
